failedFirst: a reader picture’s name and link > is named after the note and the graph, ending .thoughtknot.svg, safe on every platform
a reader picture’s name and link > is linked relative to the note, as GitHub and every Markdown reader resolve it, and read back the same
the image line after a block > is a plain Markdown image, its alt on one line with its brackets escaped
the image line after a block > goes straight after the block’s closing fence, in place of the one there, keeping the note’s line endings
the image line after a block > is taken away alone, and only the ones asked for
whether a picture is up to date > is the fingerprint of the blocks of its graph alone, and of the note it names
whether a picture is up to date > is read only from the picture’s own mark: none, current, old, or not made by ThoughtKnot
the alt text > is the plain-language reading on one line, cut between words to a set length
a reader picture > is an SVG file to link by one image line after the block, named after the note and the graph
a reader picture > carries its title, legend, who drew it from which note and when, its own page, and its reading as alt text
a reader picture > names itself as ThoughtKnot’s with the fingerprint of its text, and the same text gives the same bytes
a reader picture > is made from the text alone: no picture file is an input, so changing or deleting one changes nothing
a reader picture > of a graph too large to draw is its overview, with a line saying what is left out
a reader picture > whose layout refuses is its overview too, and one no longer wanted is nothing
a reader picture > of a note classified above the level is asked about first, and made once the user says yes
a reader picture > of a graph with nothing in it is none, and says why
